verses.uthmani: وَٱلطُّورِ
verses.indopak: وَالطُّوۡرِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: ﻿waalttoori
verses.saheeh: By the mount
verses.khattab: By Mount Ṭûr
verses.jalalayn: ﻿By the Mount, that is, the [name of the] mountain on which God spoke to Moses,
verses.romanUrdu: Kasam hai Tur (Mount) ki

verses.uthmani: وَكِتَٰبٍۢ مَّسْطُورٍۢ
verses.indopak: وَكِتٰبٍ مَّسۡطُوۡرٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: wakitabin mastoorin
verses.saheeh: And [by] a Book inscribed
verses.khattab: And by the Book written
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and an inscribed Book,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur ek aisi khuli kitaab ki

verses.uthmani: فِى رَقٍّۢ مَّنشُورٍۢ
verses.indopak: فِىۡ رَقٍّ مَّنۡشُوۡرٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: fee raqqin manshoorin
verses.saheeh: In parchment spread open
verses.khattab: on open pages ˹for all to read˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿on an unrolled parchment, that is, the Torah or the Qur'an.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo raqeeq jild(fine parchment) mein likkhi hui hai

verses.uthmani: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
verses.indopak: وَالۡبَيۡتِ الۡمَعۡمُوۡرِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waalbayti alma'moori
verses.saheeh: And [by] the frequented House
verses.khattab: And by the ˹Sacred˺ House frequently visited
verses.jalalayn: ﻿By the [greatly] frequented House — which is [located] in the third, or the sixth or the seventh heaven, directly above the Ka‘ba; it is visited every day by seventy thousand angels, circumambulating it and performing prayers [around it], and never returning to it;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur aabaad (much-frequented) ghar ki

verses.uthmani: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
verses.indopak: وَالسَّقۡفِ الۡمَرۡفُوۡعِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waalssaqfi almarfoo'i
verses.saheeh: And [by] the heaven raised high
verses.khattab: And by the canopy raised ˹high˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the raised roof, that is to say, the heaven,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unchi chatt (canopy) ki

verses.uthmani: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
verses.indopak: وَالۡبَحۡرِ الۡمَسۡجُوۡرِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waalbahri almasjoori
verses.saheeh: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],
verses.khattab: And by the seas set on fire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the swarming sea: that is to say, the one that is filled:
verses.romanUrdu: Aur maujzan samandar (swelling sea) ki

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لوَاقِعٌ ۙ
verses.transliteration: inna 'athaba rabbika lawaqi'un
verses.saheeh: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
verses.khattab: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will come to pass—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿lo! your Lord’s chastisement will assuredly take place, it will assuredly come down on those who deserve it;
verses.romanUrdu: Ke tere Rubb ka azaab zaroor waqeh honay wala hai

verses.uthmani: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍۢ
verses.indopak: مَّا لَهٗ مِنۡ دَافِعٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: ma lahu min dafi'in
verses.saheeh: Of it there is no preventer.
verses.khattab: none will avert it—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿there is none that can avert it, from such [a deserving one].
verses.romanUrdu: Jisey koi dafa karne wala nahin

verses.uthmani: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًۭا
verses.indopak: يَّوۡمَ تَمُوۡرُ السَّمَآءُ مَوۡرًا ۙ
verses.transliteration: yawma tamooru alssamao mawran
verses.saheeh: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
verses.khattab: on the Day the heavens will be shaken violently
verses.jalalayn: ﻿On the day (yawma is operated by la-wāqi‘un, ‘will assuredly take place’) when the heaven will heave with a great heaving, [when it will] move and spin,
verses.romanUrdu: Woh us roz waqeh hoga jab aasmaan buri tarah dagmagayega

verses.uthmani: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًۭا
verses.indopak: وَّتَسِيۡرُ الۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرًا ؕ
verses.transliteration: wataseeru aljibalu sayran
verses.saheeh: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
verses.khattab: and the mountains will be blown away entirely
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the mountains move with a great motion, becoming scattered dust, this is the Day of Resurrection.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur pahad udey udey phirenge

verses.uthmani: فَوَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.indopak: فَوَيۡلٌ يَّوۡمَٮِٕذٍ لِّـلۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: fawaylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
verses.saheeh: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
verses.khattab: Then woe on that Day to the deniers—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Woe then, terrible chastisement [will come], on that day to the deniers, of the messengers,
verses.romanUrdu: Tabahi hai us roz un jhutlane walon ke liye

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.indopak: الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ فِىۡ خَوۡضٍ يَّلۡعَبُوۡنَ ۘ
verses.transliteration: allatheena hum fee khawdin yal'aboona
verses.saheeh: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
verses.khattab: those who amuse themselves with falsehood
verses.jalalayn: ﻿those who play around in vain talk, [in] falsehood, that is to say, those who are busily engaged with their disbelief;
verses.romanUrdu: Jo aaj khel ke taur par apni hujjat baaziyon mein lagey huey hain

verses.uthmani: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
verses.indopak: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّوۡنَ اِلٰى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا ؕ
verses.transliteration: yawma yuda''oona ila nari jahannama da''an
verses.saheeh: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
verses.khattab: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be fiercely shoved into the Fire of Hell
verses.jalalayn: ﻿the day when they will be thrust with a violent thrust into Hell, [when] they will be pushed violently (this [last clause, yawma yuda‘‘ūna ilā nāri jahannama da‘‘an] is a substitution for yawma tamūru, ‘the day when [the heaven] will heave’) and it will be said to them in reproach:
verses.romanUrdu: Jis din unhein dhakke maar maar kar naar-e-jahannum (fire of hell) ki taraf le chala jayega

verses.uthmani: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.indopak: هٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِىۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: hathihi alnnaru allatee kuntum biha tukaththiboona
verses.saheeh: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
verses.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Fire which you used to deny
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘This is the Fire which you used to deny!
verses.romanUrdu: Us waqt unse kaha jayega ke “ yeh wahi aag hai jisey tum jhutlaya karte thay

verses.uthmani: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.indopak: اَفَسِحۡرٌ هٰذَاۤ اَمۡ اَنۡتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: afasihrun hatha am antum la tubsiroona
verses.saheeh: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
verses.khattab: Is this magic, or do you not see
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Is this then sorcery, [this] chastisement that you see — as you were wont to say about the revelation, that it was sorcery — or is it that you do not see?
verses.romanUrdu: Ab batao yeh jaadu hai ya tumhein soojh nahin raha hai

verses.uthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: اِصۡلَوۡهَا فَاصۡبِرُوۡۤا اَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُوۡا ۚ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ ؕ اِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: islawha faisbiroo aw la tasbiroo sawaon 'alaykum innama tujzawna ma kuntum ta'maloona
verses.saheeh: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
verses.khattab: Burn in it! It is the same whether you endure ˹it˺ patiently or not. You are only rewarded for what you used to do.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Burn in it! And whether you endure, it, or do not endure, your endurance and your anguish, will be the same for you, because your endurance will be of no use to you. You are only being requited for what you used to do’, that is to say, [only] the requital for it.
verses.romanUrdu: Jao ab jhulso iske andar, tum khwa sabr karo ya na karo, tumhare liye yaksan hai, tumhein waisa hi badla diya ja raha hai jaise tum amal kar rahey thay

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَعِيمٍۢ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِىۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّنَعِيۡمٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wana'eemin
verses.saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
verses.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will be in Gardens and bliss
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly the God-fearing will be amid gardens and bliss,
verses.romanUrdu: Muttaqi log wahan baagon (gardens) aur niyamaton mein hongey

verses.uthmani: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.indopak: فٰكِهِيۡنَ بِمَاۤ اٰتٰٮهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ ۚ وَوَقٰٮهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ الۡجَحِيۡمِ
verses.transliteration: fakiheena bima atahum rabbuhum wawaqahum rabbuhum 'athaba aljaheemi
verses.saheeh: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
verses.khattab: enjoying whatever their Lord will have granted them. And their Lord will have protected them from the torment of the Hellfire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿rejoicing, delighting, in what (bi-mā relates to the verbal action) their Lord has given them, and [that] their Lord has shielded them from the chastisement of Hell-fire (wa-waqāhum rabbuhum ‘adhāba’l-jahīmi is a supplement to ātāhum, ‘[what He] has given them’, in other words, [rejoicing] in their having been given [this reward] and shielded [from Hell-fire]).
verses.romanUrdu: Lutf le rahe hongey un cheezon se jo unka Rubb unhein dega, aur unka Rubb unhein dozakh ke azaab se bacha lega

verses.uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: كُلُوۡا وَاشۡرَبُوۡا هَـنِٓـيـْئًا ۢ بِمَا كُنۡـتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum ta'maloona
verses.saheeh: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
verses.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it will said to them: ‘Eat and drink in full enjoyment (hanī’an is a circumstantial qualifier, that is to say, muhanna’īna) [as a reward] for what (bi-mā: the bi- is causative) you used to do’.
verses.romanUrdu: (Unse kaha jayega) khao aur peo mazey se apne un aamaal ke siley mein jo tum karte rahey ho

verses.uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
verses.indopak: مُتَّكِـــِٕيۡنَ عَلٰى سُرُرٍ مَّصۡفُوۡفَةٍ ۚ وَزَوَّجۡنٰهُمۡ بِحُوۡرٍ عِيۡنٍ
verses.transliteration: muttakieena 'ala sururin masfoofatin wazawwajnahum bihoorin 'eenin
verses.saheeh: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
verses.khattab: They will be reclining on thrones, ˹neatly˺ lined up ˹facing each other˺. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[They will be] reclining (muttaki’īna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the concealed subject of God’s words fī jannātin, ‘amid gardens’) on ranged couches, [arranged] one next to the other, and We will wed them (zawwajnāhum is a supplement to jannātin, ‘gardens’, meaning ‘We will couple them’) to beautiful houris, of wide and beautiful eyes.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh aamne saamne bichey huey takhaton(thrones) par takiye(couches) lagaye baithey hongey aur hum khoobsurat aankhon waali hoorein unse biyah (marry) denge

verses.uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ
verses.indopak: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَاتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُمۡ بِاِيۡمَانٍ اَلۡحَـقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَاۤ اَلَـتۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِمۡ مِّنۡ شَىۡءٍ ؕ كُلُّ امۡرِیءٍۢ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِيۡنٌ
verses.transliteration: waallatheena amanoo waittaba'athum thurriyyatuhum bieemanin alhaqna bihim thurriyyatahum wama alatnahum min 'amalihim min shayin kullu imriin bima kasaba raheenun
verses.saheeh: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
verses.khattab: As for those who believe and whose descendants follow them in faith, We will elevate their descendants to their rank, never discounting anything ˹of the reward˺ of their deeds. Every person will reap only what they sowed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And those who believed (wa’lladhīna āmanū, the subject) and whom We made to be followed (wa-atba‘nāhum: a variant reading has wa’ttaba‘athum, ‘and there followed them’, as a supplement to āmanū, ‘who believed’) by their descendants (dhurrīyātihim: a variant reading [for this plural] has dhurrīyatuhum), young and old, in faith, on the part of the older ones and on the part of the parents in [their] young ones (the predicate [of the subject above] is [the following, alhaqnā bihim), We will make their, mentioned, descendants join them, in Paradise, so that they are in the same degree [of reward], even though they might not have performed the same [meritorious] deeds as them [to deserve this equal status], a way of honouring the parents by having their children join them [again]; and We will not deprive them (read alatnāhum or alitnāhum), [We will not] diminish [them], of anything (min shay’in: min is extra) of their deeds, in order to add it to the deeds of their children. Every man is subject to what he has earned, of good or evil deeds, and will be requited for evil and rewarded for good.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo log imaan laaye hain aur unki aulad bhi kisi darja-e-imaan mein unke naksh-e-qadam par chali hai unki us aulad ko bhi hun (jannat mein) unke saath mila denge aur unke amaal mein koi ghaata(loss) unko na denge. Har shaks apne kasb ke aevaz rehan hai.( Every person is pledged to what he did)

verses.uthmani: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاَمۡدَدۡنٰهُمۡ بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَّلَحۡمٍ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: waamdadnahum bifakihatin walahmin mimma yashtahoona
verses.saheeh: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
verses.khattab: And We will ˹continually˺ provide them with whatever fruit or meat they desire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We will supply them, We will enhance for them [their provision], from time to time, with fruits and meat, such as they desire, even if they do not request it openly.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum unko har tarah ke phal (fruits) aur gosht , jis cheez ko bhi unka ji chahega khoob diye chale jayenge

verses.uthmani: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ
verses.indopak: يَـتَـنَازَعُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا كَاۡسًا لَّا لَغۡوٌ فِيۡهَا وَلَا تَاۡثِيۡمٌ
verses.transliteration: yatanaza'oona feeha kasan la laghwun feeha wala tatheemun
verses.saheeh: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
verses.khattab: They will pass around to each other a drink ˹of pure wine,˺ which leads to no idle talk or sinfulness
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They will pass from one to another therein, in Paradise, a cup, [of] wine, wherein is neither vain talk, which might come about between them as a result of drinking it, nor cause for sin, thereby, that might befall them — in contrast to [the case with] the wine of this world.
verses.romanUrdu: Wahan woh ek dusre se jaam-e-sharaab lapak lapak kar le rahey hongey jis mein na yawa-goyi (ill speech) hogi na bad-kirdari

wbw.translation: They will pass to one another

verses.uthmani: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
verses.indopak: وَيَطُوۡفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانٌ لَّهُمۡ كَاَنَّهُمۡ لُـؤۡلُـؤٌ مَّكۡنُوۡنٌ
verses.transliteration: wayatoofu 'alayhim ghilmanun lahum kaannahum luluon maknoonun
verses.saheeh: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
verses.khattab: And they will be waited on by their youthful servants like spotless pearls
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And there will circulate from all around them, for service, youths, delicate [in demeanour], of their own, as if, in terms of their beauty and immaculateness, they were hidden pearls, preserved inside shells, because when it [a pearl] is inside it, it is better than one that is not.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unki khidmat mein woh ladke daudte (running) phir rahey hongey jo unhi ke liye makhsoos hongey, aisey khoobsurat jaise chupa kar rakkhe huey moti(pearls)

verses.uthmani: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلٰى بَعۡضٍ يَّتَسَآءَلُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: waaqbala ba'duhum 'ala ba'din yatasaaloona
verses.saheeh: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
verses.khattab: They will turn to one another inquisitively
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And some among them will turn to one another, questioning each other — they ask one another about how they were in the past and what they have now attained, in their delight and acknowledgement of the grace [of God to them].
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh log apas mein ek dusre se (duniya mein guzre huey) halaat puchenge

verses.uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
verses.indopak: قَالُـوۡۤا اِنَّا كُـنَّا قَبۡلُ فِىۡۤ اَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِيۡنَ
verses.transliteration: qaloo inna kunna qablu fee ahlina mushfiqeena
verses.saheeh: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah].
verses.khattab: They will say, “Before ˹this reward˺ we used to be in awe ˹of Allah˺ in the midst of our people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They say, as an intimation of the reason for this attainment: ‘Truly, before, amid our families, in the world, we used to be ever anxious, afraid of God’s chastisement;
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh kahenge ke hum pehle apne ghar waalon mein darte huey zindagi basar karte thay

verses.uthmani: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.indopak: فَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقٰٮنَا عَذَابَ السَّمُوۡمِ
verses.transliteration: famanna allahu 'alayna wawaqana 'athaba alssamoomi
verses.saheeh: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
verses.khattab: So Allah has graced us and protected us from the torment of ˹Hell’s˺ scorching heat
verses.jalalayn: ﻿but God showed us favour, through [His] forgiveness, and shielded us from the piercing chastisement (al-samūm), the Fire, so called because it penetrates the pores (al-masāmm); and they say, also by way of intimation:
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir e kaar Allah ne hum par fazl farmaya aur humein jhulsa dene wali hawa ke azaab se bacha liya

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.indopak: اِنَّا كُـنَّا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوۡهُ ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡبَـرُّ الرَّحِيۡمُ
verses.transliteration: inna kunna min qablu nad'oohu innahu huwa albarru alrraheemu
verses.saheeh: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
verses.khattab: Indeed, we used to call upon Him ˹alone˺ before. He is truly the Most Kind, Most Merciful.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿indeed before, that is, in the world, we used to call on Him, worship Him, affirming His Oneness. Verily He is (read innahu as the beginning of a new [independent] sentence, even if it introduces the reason in terms of its import; or read annahu as a reason in terms of the [syntactical] order of the words) the Benign, the Beneficent, the True to His promise, the Merciful, One of tremendous mercy.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum pichli zindagi mein usi se duaein maangte thay, woh waqai bada hi Mohsin (beneficent) aur Raheem hai

verses.uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
verses.indopak: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَاۤ اَنۡتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَّلَا مَجۡنُوۡنٍ ؕ
verses.transliteration: fathakkir fama anta bini'mati rabbika bikahin wala majnoonin
verses.saheeh: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
verses.khattab: So ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺. For you, by the grace of your Lord, are not a fortune-teller or a madman
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So remind, persist in reminding the idolaters and do not desist [from this] even if they say to you that you are a soothsayer or a madman. For by the grace of your Lord, by His bestowal of grace on you, you are neither soothsayer (bi-kāhinin is the predicate of mā) nor madman (wa-lā majnūnin, a supplement to it).
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aey nabi, tum nasihat kiye jao, apne Rubb ke fazal se na tum kaahin (soothsayer) ho aur na majnoon (madman)

verses.uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَـرَبَّصُ بِهٖ رَيۡبَ الۡمَنُوۡنِ
verses.transliteration: am yaqooloona sha'irun natarabbasu bihi rayba almanooni
verses.saheeh: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"
verses.khattab: Or do they say, “˹He is˺ a poet, for whom we ˹eagerly˺ await an ill-fate!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or (am means bal) do they say, that he is: ‘A poet, for whom we may await the accidents of fate?’, the vicissitudes of time, so that he will just die like other poets.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya yeh log kehte hain ke yeh shaks shayar hai jiske haqq mein hum gardish-e-ayyam (misfortune) ke intizaar kar rahe hain

verses.uthmani: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
verses.indopak: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُوۡا فَاِنِّىۡ مَعَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡمُتَـرَبِّصِيۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: qul tarabbasoo fainnee ma'akum mina almutarabbiseena
verses.saheeh: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
verses.khattab: Say, “Keep waiting! I too am waiting with you.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say: ‘Await!, my death. For I too will be with you awaiting’, your death. They were then chastised with [death by] the sword on the day of Badr.
verses.romanUrdu: Inse kaho, accha intizaar karo, main bhi tumhare saath intizaar karta hoon

verses.uthmani: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ تَاۡمُرُهُمۡ اَحۡلَامُهُمۡ بِهٰذَآ اَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ طَاغُوۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: am tamuruhum ahlamuhum bihatha am hum qawmun taghoona
verses.saheeh: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
verses.khattab: Or do their ˹intelligent˺ minds prompt them to this ˹paradox˺? Or are they ˹just˺ a transgressing people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or do their faculties of understanding prompt them to [say] this?, their saying to him: [you are either] a sorcerer, a poet, a soothsayer or a madman, in other words, they do not [in reality] prompt them to [say] this. Or (am, [in effect] means bal, ‘rather’) are they a rebellious lot?, because of their obstinacy.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya inki aqalein(minds) inhein aisi hi baatein karne ke liye kehti hain? Ya dar-haqeeqat yeh inaad (transgression)mein hadd se guzare huey log hain

verses.uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ تَقَوَّلَهٗ ۚ بَلْ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: am yaqooloona taqawwalahu bal la yuminoona
verses.saheeh: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
verses.khattab: Or do they say, “He made this ˹Quran˺ up!”? In fact, they have no faith
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or do they say, ‘He has improvised it?’, he has concocted the Qur'an. He has not concocted it; Rather they do not believe, out of arrogance. If they [continue to] say that he has concocted it:
verses.romanUrdu: Kya ye kehte hain ke is shaks ne yeh quraan khud ghad (invented/fabricated) liya hai? Asal baat yeh hai ke yeh imaan nahin lana chahte

verses.uthmani: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.indopak: فَلۡيَاۡتُوۡا بِحَدِيۡثٍ مِّثۡلِهٖۤ اِنۡ كَانُوۡا صٰدِقِيۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: falyatoo bi<u>h</u>adeethin mithlihi in k<u>a</u>noo <u>sa</u>diqeena
verses.saheeh: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
verses.khattab: Let them then produce something like it, if what they say is true
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then let them bring a, concocted, discourse like it, if they are truthful, in what they say.
verses.romanUrdu: Agar yeh apne is qaul (saying) mein sacche hain to isi shaan ka ek kalaam bana layein

verses.uthmani: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ خُلِقُوۡا مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَىۡءٍ اَمۡ هُمُ الۡخٰلِقُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: am khuliqoo min ghayri shayin am humu alkhaliqoona
verses.saheeh: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
verses.khattab: Or were they created by nothing, or are they ˹their own˺ creators
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or were they created out of nothing?, [that is] without a Creator. Or are they the creators?, of themselves. It makes no sense for a created thing to have no creator, nor can a thing that will cease to existent [have the power to] create. There must be a Creator of them, and that is God, the One, so why do they not affirm His Oneness and believe in His Messenger and His Book?
verses.romanUrdu: Kya yeh kisi khaliq ke bagair khud paida ho gaye hain? Ya yeh khud apne khaliq hain

verses.uthmani: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ خَلَـقُوا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ ۚ بَلْ لَّا يُوۡقِنُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: am khalaqoo alssamawati waalarda bal la yooqinoona
verses.saheeh: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
verses.khattab: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they have no firm belief ˹in Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nor can any but God, the Creator, have created them, so why do they not worship Him? Nay, but they are not certain, of Him, for otherwise they would have believed in His Prophet.
verses.romanUrdu: Ya zameen aur aasmaano ko inhon ne paida kiya hai? Asal baat yeh hai ke yeh yaqeen nahin rakhte

verses.uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ عِنۡدَهُمۡ خَزَآٮِٕنُ رَبِّكَ اَمۡ هُمُ الۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: am 'indahum khazainu rabbika am humu almusaytiroona
verses.saheeh: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
verses.khattab: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord, or are they in control ˹of everything˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord?, in the way of prophethood, provision and other matters, so that they are able to assign what they will exclusively to whom they will? Or are they the ones in control?, [or] are they the mighty ones who hold sway? (the verb [from musaytirūna] is saytara, similar [in root form] to baytara, ‘to practice veterinary medicine’, or bayqara, ‘to corrupt’, ‘to ruin’).
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tere Rubb ke khazane in ke kabze mein hain? Ya un par inhi ka hukum chalta hai

verses.uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمٌ يَّسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ فِيۡهِ ۚ فَلۡيَاۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُمۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ ؕ
verses.transliteration: am lahum sullamun yastami'oona feehi falyati mustami'uhum bisultanin mubeenin
verses.saheeh: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.
verses.khattab: Or do they have a stairway, by which they eavesdrop ˹on the heavens˺? Then let those who do so bring a compelling proof
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or do they have a ladder, a means of ascension into the heaven, whereby they eavesdrop?, that is, at the top of which [they listen in], on the conversations of the angels, so that they are then able to dispute with the Prophet, as they claim. If that is what they assert: Then let their eavesdropper, [let] the one claiming to be able to listen [in on their conversations] on top of this [ladder], produce a manifest warrant, a plain and evident proof. Now, on account of the similarity of this assertion to their assertion that the angels are the daughters of God, He, exalted be He, says:
verses.romanUrdu: Kya inke paas koi seedi(ladder) hai jispar chadh kar yeh ilm-e-baala ki sun-gun letey hain? In mein se jisne sun-gun li ho woh laaye ko khuli daleel

verses.uthmani: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ لَـهُ الۡبَنٰتُ وَلَـكُمُ الۡبَنُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: am lahu albanatu walakumu albanoona
verses.saheeh: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
verses.khattab: Or does He have daughters ˹as you claim˺, while you ˹prefer to˺ have sons
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or does He have daughters, as you claim, whereas you have sons? Exalted be God above what you claim!
verses.romanUrdu: Kya Allah ke liye to hain betiyan aur tum logon ke liye hain betay (sons)

verses.uthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ تَسۡـَٔـلُهُمۡ اَجۡرًا فَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّغۡرَمٍ مُّثۡقَلُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona
verses.saheeh: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
verses.khattab: Or are you ˹O Prophet˺ asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or are you asking them for a fee, a wage in return for what you have brought them in the way of religion, so that they are weighed down with debt?, [with] the liability for this, so that they are unable to submit [to God].
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tum insey koi ajar maangte ho key eh zabardasti padi hui chatti ke bojh taley dabey jatey hain (burdened with a load of debt)

verses.uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ عِنۡدَهُمُ الۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: am 'indahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboona
verses.saheeh: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
verses.khattab: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or do they have [access to] the Unseen, that is, the knowledge of it, so that they can write it down?, and are hence able to dispute with the Prophet (s) regarding the Resurrection and the matters relating to the Hereafter, as they claim.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya inke paas gaib ke haqaiq ka ilm hai ke uski bina par yeh likh rahe hoon

verses.uthmani: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ يُرِيۡدُوۡنَ كَيۡدًا ؕ فَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا هُمُ الۡمَكِيۡدُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: am yureedoona kaydan faallatheena kafaroo humu almakeedoona
verses.saheeh: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
verses.khattab: Or do they intend to scheme ˹against the Prophet˺? Then it is the disbelievers who will fall victim to ˹their˺ schemes
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or do they desire to outmanoeuvre?, you and have you killed, at the Assembly Council. But those who disbelieve, they are the outmanoeuvred ones!, the vanquished and the ones destroyed. God preserved him from them and then destroyed them at Badr.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya yeh koi chaal chalna chahte hain? (agar yeh baat hai) to kufr karne walon par in ki chaal ulti hi padegi

verses.uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ اِلٰهٌ غَيۡرُ اللّٰهِ ؕ سُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: am lahum ilahun ghayru allahi subhana allahi 'amma yushrikoona
verses.saheeh: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
verses.khattab: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glorified is Allah far above what they associate ˹with Him˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or do they have a god other than God? Glory be to God [exalted is He] above any partners that they may ascribe!, to Him in the way of gods (the succession of interrogatives with am, ‘or’, are intended to express censure and rebuke).
verses.romanUrdu: Kya Allah ke siwa yeh koi aur maabood rakhte hain? Allah paak hai us shirk se jo yeh log kar rahey hain

verses.uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ
verses.indopak: وَاِنۡ يَّرَوۡا كِسۡفًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَّقُوۡلُوۡا سَحَابٌ مَّرۡكُوۡمٌ
verses.transliteration: wain yaraw kisfan mina alssamai saqitan yaqooloo sahabun markoomun
verses.saheeh: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
verses.khattab: If they were to see a ˹deadly˺ piece of the sky fall down ˹upon them˺, still they would say, “˹This is just˺ a pile of clouds.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And if they were to see a fragment, a portion, of the heaven falling, on them — as they say, Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us [Q. 26:187], as a chastisement for them — they would say, this is: ‘A heap of clouds!’, piled on top of one another, that will bring us water; and so they do not believe.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh log aasmaan ke tukde bhi girte huye dekh lein to kahenge yeh baadal hain jo umdey chale aa rahe hain

verses.uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
verses.indopak: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتّٰى يُلٰقُوۡا يَوۡمَهُمُ الَّذِىۡ فِيۡهِ يُصۡعَقُوۡنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: fatharhum hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee feehi yus'aqoona
verses.saheeh: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
verses.khattab: So leave them until they face their Day in which they will be struck dead—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So leave them until they encounter that day of theirs in which they will be thunderstruck, [in which] they will die;
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aey nabi, inhein inke haal par chodh do yahan tak ke yeh apne us din ko pahunch jayein jismein yeh maar giraye jayenge

verses.uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.indopak: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِىۡ عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔـا وَّلَا هُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَ ؕ
verses.transliteration: yawma la yughnee 'anhum kayduhum shayan wala hum yunsaroona
verses.saheeh: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
verses.khattab: the Day their scheming will be of no benefit to them whatsoever, nor will they be helped
verses.jalalayn: ﻿the day when their guile will avail them nothing (yawma lā yughnī is a substitution for yawmahumu, ‘that day of theirs’) and they will not be helped, they will [not] be protected from the chastisement in the Hereafter.
verses.romanUrdu: Jis din na inki apni koi chaal inke kisi kaam aayegi na koi inki madad ko aayega

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاِنَّ لِلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا عَذَابًا دُوۡنَ ذٰلِكَ وَلٰـكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.transliteration: wainna lillatheena thalamoo 'athaban doona thalika walakinna aktharahum la ya'lamoona
verses.saheeh: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
verses.khattab: Also, the wrongdoers will certainly have another torment before that ˹Day˺, but most of them do not know
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And assuredly for those who do wrong, by their [persistence in] disbelief, there is a chastisement beyond that, in this world, before their death — thus they were punished with famine and drought for seven years, and with being killed on the day of Badr; but most of them do not know, that the chastisement will befall them.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur us waqt ke aane se pehle bhi zalimon ke liye ek azaab hai, magar in mein se aksar jaante nahin hain

verses.uthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.indopak: وَاصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَاِنَّكَ بِاَعۡيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِيۡنَ تَقُوۡمُ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waisbir lihukmi rabbika fainnaka bia'yunina wasabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoomu
verses.saheeh: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
verses.khattab: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, for you are truly under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord, that they be reprieved, and do not be grieved, for surely you fare before Our eyes, [you are] in Our sight, We see you and preserve you. And glorify, continuously, with praise of your Lord, that is to say, say subhāna’Llāhi wa bi-hamdihi, ‘Glory, and praise, be to God!’, when you rise, from your sleeping-place or your sitting-place,
verses.romanUrdu: Aey Nabi , apne Rubb ka faisla aane tak sabr karo. Tum hamari nigaah mein ho. Tum jab utho to apne Rubb ki hamd ke saath uski tasbeeh karo

verses.uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.indopak: وَمِنَ الَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَاِدۡبَارَ النُّجُوۡمِ
verses.transliteration: wamina allayli fasabbihhu waidbara alnnujoomi
verses.saheeh: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
verses.khattab: And glorify Him during part of the night and at the fading of the stars
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and glorify Him at night — also in actual [utterance] — and at the receding of the stars (idbāra is a verbal noun), that is to say, also glorify Him after these have set; or [it means] in the case of the former, perform the two evening prayers, and in the case of the latter, the two units (rak‘a) of the dawn prayer, or — it is said — the morning prayer.
verses.romanUrdu: Raat ko bhi uski tasbeeh kiya karo aur sitare jab palat-te hain us waqt bhi
